description.text: What can you obtain from Business Chinese Course The training aims to help international students conquer obstacles in listening and speaking Business Chinese through word and sentence expanding, case discussion etc., to introduce you business culture and etiquette knowledge, to strengthen your Chinese communication ability in business environment. Who need to attend oral business Chinese course Those who want to improve the applicants’ ability of business Chinese and those who would like to work relevant to Chinese businessTwo topicsOral Business Chinese: Professional textbooks combining Chinese language, job-hunting ability and profession business attainment To improve individual profession quality by case study, class activity and after-class practice. Basic skill of hunting job: Business Chinese Test, CV preparation, Cover letter, Interview written exam. Classes and Application Qualification Classes Mastered Glossary Finished Chinese class hours Preliminary 1200 300 class hours Intermediate 2500 600 class hours Advanced 5000 Above 900 class hours Period of Study 1 semester or 2 semesters (1 year);

duration.text: The Business Chinese at Shanghai University of Finance and Economics is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 305 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1250 USD/per semester ￥ 9000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: 1. (Applicants should be between the) age of 18 to 60 2.Be in good health and foreigners
